_readme: Site news feed. Edit this file, run scripts/make-updates.py, commit. The script regenerates the homepage 'What's new' grid between its UPDATES markers. First entry = lead story (large tile). 'status' is one of: live, update, dev, research, resources.

updates.title: GeoHUB: the hazard record on a 3D globe
updates.desc: 312,500 earthquakes back to 1008 and every cyclone track since 1842, played through time; world geology, live events, satellites, drawing and sampling. Free, no account.
updates.alt: The GeoHUB globe with 312,500 earthquakes plotted and a playback timeline

updates.title: Six hazard models, open to members
updates.desc: Landslide and slope stability from GFS rainfall, flood by discharge, cyclone, seismic, volcanic ashfall and sea level — with rock properties, the Model Builder and Earth Engine. £49.99 a year.
updates.alt: Rock strength derived from mapped lithology on the GeoHUB globe

updates.title: ASCENT — climb Everest in your browser
updates.desc: Walk the real mountain: Esri imagery over a live elevation model, the South Col route, oxygen, weather and crevasses. Pick a camp and go.

updates.title: The Mars Flight Simulator
updates.desc: MOLA relief with the CTX mosaic streamed beneath you, from an 8 km low pass to 300 km orbit. Launch from anywhere on the planet.

updates.title: Mount Etna in 3D
updates.desc: 12,000 INGV earthquakes over the magma plumbing, regional faults, the geological map and a live cross-section, summit to coastline.

updates.title: The methods behind the models, written up
updates.desc: Three notes in the Journal: the forecast landslide and flood model from GFS rainfall, probabilistic ashfall by eruption size, and the merged global earthquake record.
updates.alt: An earthquake popup in GeoHUB showing a seismogram and spectrogram
